def _record_runtime_recovery_audit(
    state_root: Path,
    entry: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    """Append one secret-free runtime convergence recovery audit entry."""
    audit_path = state_root / "maintenance" / "runtime_recovery_audit.jsonl"

def execute_bounded_runtime_convergence_recovery(
    *,
    incident_id: str,
    requester_email: str,
    repo_root: Path | None = None,
    state_root: Path | None = None,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Bounded, idempotent, auditable, fail-closed runtime convergence recovery.

    Breaks the circular dependency between Repair Planner / WORKER_REPAIR_BOUNDED
    and runtime convergence without exposing arbitrary shell, without touching
    Production, and without discarding legitimate non-platform local commits.
    """
    if _is_production_env():
        raise ValueError("RUNTIME_RECOVERY_PRODUCTION_FORBIDDEN")

    clean_incident = str(incident_id or "").strip()
    clean_email = str(requester_email or "").strip().lower()
    if not clean_incident:
        raise ValueError("INCIDENT_ID_REQUIRED")
    if not clean_email or "@" not in clean_email:
        raise ValueError("REQUESTER_EMAIL_REQUIRED")

    root = repo_root or ROOT
    qroot = state_root or (root / ".git" / "universal-worker-queue")
    from tools.mirror_sync import git_divergence_guard as gdg
    from tools.mirror_sync.worker_runtime_fingerprint import build_mcp_runtime_convergence_report

    before = build_mcp_runtime_convergence_report(repo_root=root, state_root=qroot)
    if before.get("overall_converged") is True:
        outcome = {
            "schema": "edarsahub.runtime-convergence-recovery.v1",
            "recovery_kind": "RUNTIME_CONVERGENCE_RECOVERY",
            "incident_id": clean_incident,
            "requester_email": clean_email,
            "status": "ALREADY_CONVERGED",
            "overall_converged": True,
            "duplicate_prevented": True,
            "git_recovery": None,
            "runtime_autoconvergence": None,
            "before": {
                "local_head": before.get("local_head"),
                "remote_development_head": before.get("remote_development_head"),
                "head_aligned": before.get("head_aligned"),
                "overall_converged": True,
            },
            "after": {
                "local_head": before.get("local_head"),
                "remote_development_head": before.get("remote_development_head"),
                "head_aligned": before.get("head_aligned"),
                "overall_converged": True,
            },
            "production_touched": False,
            "recorded_at_utc": utc_now(),
        }
        if not dry_run:
            _record_runtime_recovery_audit(qroot, outcome)
        return outcome

    branch = str(before.get("branch") or "").strip()
    if branch != DEV_BRANCH:
        raise ValueError(f"RUNTIME_RECOVERY_WRONG_BRANCH:{branch}")

    git_recovery: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    if before.get("head_aligned") is not True:
        topo = gdg.inspect_repository(root)
        cls_name = str(topo.get("classification") or "").upper()
        ahead_n = int(topo.get("ahead_count") or 0)
        behind_n = int(topo.get("behind_count") or 0)
        if ahead_n >= 1 and behind_n == 0 and topo.get("merge_base") == topo.get("remote_head"):
            plat = gdg.classify_platform_only_local_ahead(root, topo)
            if not plat.get("eligible"):
                blocked = {
                    "schema": "edarsahub.runtime-convergence-recovery.v1",
                    "recovery_kind": "RUNTIME_CONVERGENCE_RECOVERY",
                    "incident_id": clean_incident,
                    "requester_email": clean_email,
                    "status": "BLOCKED_HUMAN_REQUIRED",
                    "reason": f"HUMAN_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED:{plat.get('reason') or 'NON_PLATFORM_LOCAL_COMMITS'}",
                    "overall_converged": False,
                    "preserved_commits": plat.get("commits") or [],
                    "production_touched": False,
                    "recorded_at_utc": utc_now(),
                }
                if not dry_run:
                    _record_runtime_recovery_audit(qroot, blocked)
                return blocked
            git_recovery = gdg.recover_platform_only_local_ahead(
                root,
                owner=f"bounded-recovery:{clean_incident}",
                dry_run=dry_run,
            )
        elif cls_name == "BEHIND_ONLY":
            if dry_run:
                git_recovery = {
                    "recovered": False,
                    "dry_run": True,
                    "status": "ELIGIBLE_FAST_FORWARD",
                    "local_head_before": topo.get("local_head"),
                    "remote_head": topo.get("remote_head"),
                    "production_touched": False,
                }
            else:
                ff_res = gdg.fast_forward_refresh(root)
                git_recovery = {
                    "recovered": bool(ff_res.get("fast_forwarded") or ff_res.get("status") == "ALIGNED"),
                    "dry_run": False,
                    "status": str(ff_res.get("status") or "FAST_FORWARD_REFRESH"),
                    "details": ff_res,
                    "production_touched": False,
                }
        else:
            blocked = {
                "schema": "edarsahub.runtime-convergence-recovery.v1",
                "recovery_kind": "RUNTIME_CONVERGENCE_RECOVERY",
                "incident_id": clean_incident,
                "requester_email": clean_email,
                "status": "BLOCKED_HUMAN_REQUIRED",
                "reason": f"HUMAN_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED:GIT_TOPOLOGY_{cls_name}",
                "overall_converged": False,
                "topology": {
                    "local_head": topo.get("local_head"),
                    "remote_head": topo.get("remote_head"),
                    "ahead_count": topo.get("ahead_count"),
                    "behind_count": topo.get("behind_count"),
                },
                "production_touched": False,
                "recorded_at_utc": utc_now(),
            }
            if not dry_run:
                _record_runtime_recovery_audit(qroot, blocked)
            return blocked

    runtime_autoconv: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    if not dry_run and repo_root is None:
        try:
            runtime_autoconv = converge_runtime_permanently(
                ff={"status": "BOUNDED_RECOVERY"},
                runtime={"current_job_id": read_text(RUNTIME / "current_job_id")},
            )
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            runtime_autoconv = {"status": "AUTOCONVERGENCE_ERROR", "error": type(exc).__name__}

    after = build_mcp_runtime_convergence_report(repo_root=root, state_root=qroot)
    converged_now = bool(after.get("overall_converged") is True)
    outcome = {
        "schema": "edarsahub.runtime-convergence-recovery.v1",
        "recovery_kind": "RUNTIME_CONVERGENCE_RECOVERY",
        "incident_id": clean_incident,
        "requester_email": clean_email,
        "status": (
            "PREFLIGHT_READY"
            if dry_run
            else ("CONVERGED" if converged_now else "PARTIAL_RECOVERY_PENDING_RUNTIME")
        ),
        "overall_converged": converged_now,
        "duplicate_prevented": False,
        "preserved_branch": (git_recovery or {}).get("preserved_branch"),
        "git_recovery": git_recovery,
        "runtime_autoconvergence": runtime_autoconv,
        "before": {
            "local_head": before.get("local_head"),
            "remote_development_head": before.get("remote_development_head"),
            "head_aligned": before.get("head_aligned"),
            "overall_converged": bool(before.get("overall_converged")),
        },
        "after": {
            "local_head": after.get("local_head"),
            "remote_development_head": after.get("remote_development_head"),
            "head_aligned": after.get("head_aligned"),
            "overall_converged": converged_now,
        },
        "production_touched": False,
        "recorded_at_utc": utc_now(),
    }
    if not dry_run:
        _record_runtime_recovery_audit(qroot, outcome)
    return outcome

def invalidate_stale_consent_request(
    consent_request_id: str,
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    domain: str | None = None,
    reason: str = "BASE_HEAD_OR_SHA_DIVERGED",
    state_root: Path | None = None,
    repo_root: Path | None = None,
    identity_resolver: Any = None,
    now_utc: datetime | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Canonically invalidate a PENDING/APPROVED consent request ONLY when live HEAD or SHA-256 diverged.

    If live HEAD, file SHA-256, and TTL remain valid, preserves the existing consent request
    (status=STILL_VALID, invalidated=False) so it can be reused without duplication.
    Never auto-approves.
    """
    actor = _validate_authorized_actor_identity(current_user, identity_resolver=identity_resolver)
    qroot = state_root or (Path(os.environ.get("EDARSAHUB_ROOT", "/app")) / ".git" / "universal-worker-queue")
    rroot = repo_root or Path(os.environ.get("EDARSAHUB_ROOT", "/app"))
    clean_id = _safe_id(consent_request_id)
    if not clean_id:
        raise GateAuthorizationError("CONSENT_REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED")

    cdir = _consent_requests_dir(qroot)
    cdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lock_path = cdir / ".consent_requests.lock"
    with open(lock_path, "a+", encoding="utf-8") as lock_fh:
        fcntl.flock(lock_fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        try:
            path = cdir / f"{clean_id}.json"
            doc = _read_json_safe(path)
            if not isinstance(doc, dict) or doc.get("schema") != SCHEMA_CONSENT_REQUEST:
                raise GateAuthorizationError("CONSENT_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND")
            if doc.get("production_allowed") is True:
                raise GateAuthorizationError("PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_FORBIDDEN")
            if (
                int(doc.get("requested_by_usuario_id") or 0) != actor["usuario_id"]
                or str(doc.get("requested_by_email") or "").strip().lower() != actor["email"]
            ):
                raise GateAuthorizationError("CONSENT_IMPERSONATION_FORBIDDEN")
            clean_dom = str(domain or "").strip().upper()
            if clean_dom and str(doc.get("domain") or "").strip().upper() != clean_dom:
                raise GateAuthorizationError("CONSENT_DOMAIN_MISMATCH")

            now = now_utc or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            if now.tzinfo is None:
                now = now.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            now_str = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
            state = str(doc.get("status") or "").strip().upper()
            live_head = ""
            if (rroot / ".git").exists():
                proc = subprocess.run(
                    ["git", "-C", str(rroot), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                    check=False,
                    timeout=10,
                )
                if proc.returncode == 0:
                    live_head = proc.stdout.strip().lower()

            if state == "INVALIDATED_STALE_SCOPE":
                return {
                    "status": "INVALIDATED_STALE_SCOPE",
                    "invalidated": True,
                    "duplicate_prevented": True,
                    "consent_request_id": clean_id,
                    "gate_id": doc.get("gate_id"),
                    "authorization_id": doc.get("authorization_id"),
                    "domain": doc.get("domain"),
                    "scope_digest": doc.get("scope_digest"),
                    "base_head_sha": doc.get("base_head_sha"),
                    "live_head_sha": live_head or None,
                    "invalidated_reason": doc.get("invalidated_reason"),
                    "production_allowed": False,
                    "production_touched": False,
                }
            if state not in {"PENDING_HUMAN_CONSENT", "APPROVED"}:
                return {
                    "status": state,
                    "invalidated": False,
                    "consent_request_id": clean_id,
                    "gate_id": doc.get("gate_id"),
                    "authorization_id": doc.get("authorization_id"),
                    "domain": doc.get("domain"),
                    "scope_digest": doc.get("scope_digest"),
                    "live_head_sha": live_head or None,
                    "production_allowed": False,
                    "production_touched": False,
                }

            stale_reason: str | None = None
            exp_dt = _parse_iso_utc_dt(doc.get("expires_at_utc"))
            if exp_dt is None or exp_dt <= now:
                stale_reason = "CONSENT_EXPIRED"
            else:
                try:
                    _validate_gate_paths_and_hashes(
                        domain=str(doc.get("domain") or ""),
                        allowed_paths=doc.get("allowed_paths") or (),
                        source_sha256=doc.get("source_sha256") or {},
                        verification_tests=doc.get("verification_tests") or (),
                        base_head_sha=str(doc.get("base_head_sha") or ""),
                        repo_root=rroot,
                    )
                except GateAuthorizationError as exc:
                    stale_reason = str(exc)

            if stale_reason is None:
                approval_path, approval_url = _build_approval_urls(clean_id)
                return {
                    "status": "STILL_VALID",
                    "invalidated": False,
                    "consent_request_id": clean_id,
                    "gate_id": doc.get("gate_id"),
                    "authorization_id": doc.get("authorization_id"),
                    "domain": doc.get("domain"),
                    "scope_digest": doc.get("scope_digest"),
                    "base_head_sha": doc.get("base_head_sha"),
                    "live_head_sha": live_head or None,
                    "approval_path": approval_path,
                    "approval_url": approval_url,
                    "human_portal_origin": _resolve_public_approval_base_url(),
                    "mcp_public_origin": _resolve_mcp_public_origin(),
                    "target_environment": "PREVIEW_DESARROLLO",
                    "human_action_required": state == "PENDING_HUMAN_CONSENT",
                    "auto_approved": False,
                    "production_allowed": False,
                    "production_touched": False,
                }

            clean_reason = str(reason or stale_reason).strip()[:200] or stale_reason
            doc["status"] = "INVALIDATED_STALE_SCOPE"
            doc["human_approved"] = False
            doc["invalidated_at_utc"] = now_str
            doc["invalidated_by_email"] = actor["email"]
            doc["invalidated_reason"] = f"{clean_reason}:{stale_reason}"
            doc["live_head_at_invalidation"] = live_head or None
            trail = doc.get("audit_trail") if isinstance(doc.get("audit_trail"), list) else []
            trail.append({
                "event": "INVALIDATED_STALE_SCOPE",
                "at_utc": now_str,
                "actor_email": actor["email"],
                "sql_usuario_id": actor["usuario_id"],
                "stale_reason": stale_reason,
                "live_head_sha": live_head or None,
            })
            doc["audit_trail"] = trail[-50:]
            _atomic_write_json(path, doc)
            return {
                "status": "INVALIDATED_STALE_SCOPE",
                "invalidated": True,
                "duplicate_prevented": False,
                "consent_request_id": clean_id,
                "gate_id": doc.get("gate_id"),
                "authorization_id": doc.get("authorization_id"),
                "domain": doc.get("domain"),
                "scope_digest": doc.get("scope_digest"),
                "base_head_sha": doc.get("base_head_sha"),
                "live_head_sha": live_head or None,
                "invalidated_reason": doc["invalidated_reason"],
                "human_action_required": True,
                "auto_approved": False,
                "production_allowed": False,
                "production_touched": False,
            }
        finally:
            fcntl.flock(lock_fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)

def _init_repo_with_origin(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path, str]:
    bare = tmp_path / "origin.git"
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "--bare", str(bare)], check=True, capture_output=True)
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "init", "-b", "Edarsahub_Desarrollo"], check=True, capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "config", "user.name", "EDARSAHUB Worker"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "config", "user.email", "worker@edarsahub.local"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "remote", "add", "origin", str(bare)], check=True)

    (repo / ".emergent").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (repo / ".emergent" / "system_deps.txt").write_text("git\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (repo / "app.code-workspace").write_text("{}\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (repo / "backend" / "modules").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (repo / "backend" / "modules" / "demo_mod.py").write_text("X = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (repo / "backend" / "tests").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (repo / "backend" / "tests" / "test_demo_mod.py").write_text("def test_ok():\n    assert True\n", encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "add", "."], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "commit", "-m", "base"], check=True, capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "push", "-u", "origin", "Edarsahub_Desarrollo"], check=True, capture_output=True)
    base_sha = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
    return repo, bare, base_sha


def _setup_queue(repo: Path) -> Path:
    qroot = repo / ".git" / "universal-worker-queue"
    for sub in (
        "drafts",
        "pending",
        "processing",
        "done",
        "rejected",
        "results",
        "published",
        "runtime",
        "maintenance/incidents",
        "maintenance/circuit_breakers",
        "maintenance/authorizations",
        "maintenance/approvals",
        "maintenance/consent_requests",
        "maintenance/handoffs",
    ):
        (qroot / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return qroot


def test_phase1_phase2_platform_local_ahead_recovery_preserves_commits_and_blocks_code_commits(tmp_path):
    """Phase 1/2: Recover Emergent platform-only local commit non-destructively; fail closed on legitimate code commits."""
    repo, _bare, base_sha = _init_repo_with_origin(tmp_path)

    # 1. Create an Emergent platform-only local commit (exact pattern of 358bcf236)
    (repo / ".emergent" / "system_deps.txt").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (repo / "app.code-workspace").write_text('{"folders": [{"path": "."}]}\n', encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "add", ".emergent/system_deps.txt", "app.code-workspace"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(
        [
            "git", "-C", str(repo),
            "-c", "user.name=emergent-agent-e1",
            "-c", "user.email=github@emergent.sh",
            "commit", "-m", "platform auto commit",
        ],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    plat_sha = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
    assert plat_sha != base_sha

    cls = gdg.classify_platform_only_local_ahead(repo)
    assert cls["eligible"] is True
    assert cls["ahead_count"] == 1

    rec = gdg.recover_platform_only_local_ahead(repo, owner="test-recovery")
    assert rec["recovered"] is True
    assert rec["local_head_after"] == base_sha
    assert rec["reset_mode"] == "mixed_non_destructive"
    assert rec["production_touched"] is False

    # Preserved branch points to exact platform commit AND working tree file contents are preserved!
    preserved_sha = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", rec["preserved_branch"]], text=True
    ).strip()
    assert preserved_sha == plat_sha
    assert (repo / "app.code-workspace").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == '{"folders": [{"path": "."}]}\n'

    # 2. Now create a legitimate local CODE commit -> MUST FAIL CLOSED and NEVER discard!
    (repo / "backend" / "modules" / "demo_mod.py").write_text("X = 2\n", encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "add", "backend/modules/demo_mod.py"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(
        [
            "git", "-C", str(repo),
            "-c", "user.name=emergent-agent-e1",
            "-c", "user.email=github@emergent.sh",
            "commit", "-m", "legitimate code change",
        ],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    code_sha = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()

    cls_code = gdg.classify_platform_only_local_ahead(repo)
    assert cls_code["eligible"] is False
    assert cls_code["reason"] == "LOCAL_AHEAD_CONTAINS_NON_PLATFORM_CHANGES"
    with pytest.raises(gdg.GitGuardError, match="LOCAL_AHEAD_CONTAINS_NON_PLATFORM_CHANGES"):
        gdg.recover_platform_only_local_ahead(repo, owner="test-recovery")
    # HEAD MUST remain untouched on code_sha!
    assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip() == code_sha

    # Restore real CORS_ORIGINS and create a consent request

    assert created["target_environment"] == "PREVIEW_DESARROLLO"
    assert created["auto_approved"] is False

    # 3. While HEAD is unchanged, invalidate_stale_consent_request preserves it (STILL_VALID)
